messages:
morgan: Need a compact plan for rotating weight variants without dropping requests (fp16 -> q4 -> q4_0.5). Goal: atomic activation, warmup gating, safe rollback.

sasha: Summary suggestion: immutable content-addressed bundles + control-plane activation pointer + node-side lease TTL. Activation = publish pointer to new bundle hash.

tonY: Filesystem nit: we can't rely on atomic rename across mounts. Control-plane notification + node-local swap (symlink or in-memory pointer) is safer.

morgan: What about readers hitting missing files mid-activation? We need a tolerant loader that retries and falls back to previous variant until activation completes.

emily: Loader must support live manifest update without restart. Use inotify or periodic poll to pick up control-plane pointer changes and switch handles atomically in-memory.

tonY: Implementation idea: loader keeps an RCU-style pointer to active manifest and a small state machine: VALIDATING -> ACTIVE -> ROLLBACK. Swap is atomic from reader POV.

morgan: KV/prefix cache concerns: cache entries tied to variant hash; on activation, either invalidate prefix cache or tag entries by variant. We should avoid serving tokens that mix variants.

sasha: Warmup gating: require prefetch hit rate or explicit warmup probe success before marking node ACTIVE. Also set a lease TTL so nodes revert to previous variant if warmup stalls.

emily: Example warmup config I'd like in the manifest: min_prefetch_hit_rate, probe_sample_count, ttl_seconds, fallback_hash.

morgan: Proposal example:

{ warmup_min_hit_rate: "0.6", probe_samples: "100", ttl_seconds: "60", fallback_hash: "<previous>" }

emily: Also expose a grace period where both variants are acceptable for reads (for streaming handoffs), but writes/activations always target the active variant.

tonY: Rollout strategy: staged canary via routing policy. Start at 1% traffic, monitor p99 latency, error-rate, tokens/sec, and quality checks. Auto-revert on thresholds.

devbot: deploy-bot: canary deployment initiated for bundle 3c9b... on 4 nodes :rocket:

sasha: Storage: store immutable bundle files under bundles/<hash>/ and a manifest mapping layers -> path + checksum. Keeps GC deterministic.

morgan: Question: transcode (fp16 -> q4) at upload or on-node lazy? Tradeoffs: CPU at upload vs disk + first-request latency on node.

emily: Strong preference for upload-time transcode for common variants. Lazy transcode allowed as background job; until ready node should route to fallback.

tonY: Agreed. Upload-time simplifies warmup and avoids per-request stalls. Lazy as fallback only.

morgan: Action: sketch minimal manifest + control-plane endpoints for activate, validate, and lease status. @tony to draft follow-up.

tonY: I'll put up a short RFC addendum today with manifest schema and loader API (activate, check-lease, list-bundles).

morgan: Thanks all. Saving this thread as follow-up record for the activation/lease/warmup decisions.

devbot: note added to runbook "model-rotation"
